# Client-side API timeouts on reports page

The reports page spinner runs forever for large date ranges; small ranges load fine.

The client's 10s Axios timeout was shorter than the backend's response time for large report queries, so the client aborted a request the server would have completed.

1. Confirm the backend completes the query (just slowly) via server logs
2. Raise the client timeout for the reports endpoint and show progress UI
3. Add server-side pagination for large date ranges
4. Verify large-range reports load without client abort

Error Details
```
AxiosError: timeout of 10000ms exceeded (ECONNABORTED); network tab shows request pending then cancelled; backend responds in ~14s
```

Tags: frontend, timeout, econnaborted, axios, client-side
